description: Use Proproval to create and manage quotes, proposals, invoices, and client records from ChatGPT. Build drafts from saved services and pricing, update scope and terms, review totals, publish client-facing proposals after confirmation, and track proposal activity. Proproval keeps everything tied to the authenticated seller account and requires confirmation before publishing or making important changes.

defaultPrompt: Create a proposal for a client using my saved services and pricing.
Create an invoice from one of my existing proposals and show me the totals before I confirm it.
Show me recent proposal activity, including views and approvals.
